Dana (SRE): Noticed several postmortem actions are 'in progress' for months. Quick proposal: add a staleness metric + ownership SLA enforcement. Thoughts?
Victor (Oncall): Yes. Define staleness?
Dana (SRE): Staleness = days_since_last_update. Rules: staleness>14 -> auto-ping owner; unowned after 48h -> escalate to IC; unassigned & staleness>7 -> assign to oncall rota as temporary owner.
Sam (PM): Can we auto-populate owner suggestion using recent commit author + service owner? Reduces handoffs.
Ivy (Infra): Good idea. Also add "closure proof" field required to close (what to check: metric diff, smoke test, logs).
Dana (SRE): Example template for actions (to be auto-created when PM files postmortem):
```
- action: fix token refresh backoff
- owner: @suggested_owner
- due: auto(Sev->7d/21d/45d)
- closure_proof: metrics + canary
- recurrence_tag: rec:auth
- staleness: 0
```
Victor (Oncall): Comms cadence suggestion: 1) incident alert -> short triage msg in #incidents; 2) 48h status if still open; 3) weekly digest of open remediations to stakeholders; 4) final closure with closure_proof.
Sam (PM): For enforcement: if unowned after 48h, ops-helper-bot assigns to current IC as temporary owner and pages their manager if no owner after 72h. Also add weekly owner-report to managers.
Ivy (Infra): We should detect recurrence patterns differently: compute fingerprint = service + top_exception + endpoint; recurrence window = 30d; if fingerprint hits >=3 mark as 'recurring' and bump priority.
ops-helper-bot: Ops Helper: created ticket REM-3145 from postmortem "token-storm" assigned to oncall-rotation due 2026-04-08. Reminder set in 3 days.
Dana (SRE): Rotation tweak: IC rotates weekly. IC responsibilities: assign/unassign owners within 48h of incident week, run the Monday triage (15m) for actions older than 7 days, and own escalations for 48h after handoff. Add a one-line handoff note to the rota.
Victor (Oncall): I'll add the Monday 15m triage slot and update the rotation doc. Happy to chair first three sessions.
Sam (PM): I'll modify the postmortem template to include the action fields and ask the ticketing system to auto-create tasks. Will also include an optional "business impact" field so PMs can sort.
Ivy (Infra): I'll prototype the fingerprint query in observability and post results to #eng-metrics by Thursday.
Dana (SRE): Let's pilot for 30 days: measure owner_assignment_lag, staleness distribution, and recurrence hits. If we see >80% owners assigned within 48h, we'll consider it a win.
Victor (Oncall): Sounds good. Ping me when the board exists and I'll push the rota change.
